mission: 在边界清晰的交付协作中理解责任，并形成第一份可供人工复核的项目证据或复盘输入草稿。

active_golden_paths.learner_outcome: A learner reads a role-readiness and AI-capability snapshot, independently enters one bounded sandbox delivery task, can explain their collaboration responsibilities, and forms one reviewable project-evidence or retrospective-input draft without believing it was sent or added to the shared evidence ledger.

steps.person_action: Read the clearly labelled synthetic role-readiness and AI-capability snapshot.
steps.required_understanding: The snapshot is input for development, not an employment or performance decision.

steps.person_action: Enter the single sandbox task after reviewing its goal, non-goals, permitted data, timebox, and done condition.
steps.required_understanding: No real customer, project, external recipient, or production system is connected.

steps.person_action: Review the learner, collaborator, mentor, and AI responsibilities and acknowledge the learner-owned accountability boundary.
steps.required_understanding: AI may assist structure and checks; the learner owns factual accuracy and the mentor owns human review.

steps.person_action: Choose project evidence or retrospective input, complete the minimum fields, and save one browser-local draft for review.
steps.required_understanding: The saved item is a prototype-local pending draft, not shared evidence and not a message.

machine_acceptance.criterion: The contract declares exactly one active golden path and every actionable step exposes exactly one enabled primary action.

The runtime visibly identifies all profile and task content as synthetic sandbox data, lists goal, non-goals, permitted data, timebox, and done condition, and exposes no network submission or external messaging path.
Before drafting, the runtime distinguishes learner, collaborator, mentor, and AI responsibilities and requires acknowledgement of the learner accountability boundary.
Either project-evidence or retrospective-input mode can form a non-empty, timestamped, reviewable local draft, visibly labelled pending and not written to the shared Evidence Ledger.
The full path works without horizontal overflow, clipped content, or hidden primary actions at 390, 768, and 1280 CSS pixels.
Keyboard, touch-sized controls, reduced motion, validation errors, refresh re-entry, and local reset preserve one clear next action without browser console errors.

human_acceptance.criterion: Without facilitator explanation, a target learner can state the task goal, one non-goal, what data is allowed, and the done condition before entering collaboration.
Without facilitator explanation, a target learner can state what they own, what AI may assist with, and who performs human review.
A target learner independently forms either a project-evidence or retrospective-input draft and correctly identifies it as pending local evidence rather than submitted shared evidence.
Learners rate task-boundary clarity and willingness to continue to human review.
No facilitator explains the profile, task boundary, responsibility model, draft mode, or next action during the measured path.

promotion_rule: Machine acceptance may move this isolated candidate to READY_FOR_HUMAN only. Human acceptance and controller integration remain separate and cannot be inferred.
freeze_rule: Once READY_FOR_HUMAN, preserve the exact candidate until valid human evidence passes or fails it.
